blockers.description: EF game bridge construction: connecting nf_characteristic on M.carrier (sig) to rank_type/decomposition_agreement on ExtendedCarrier (muSig sig) requires proving that depth-k NF determines nf_profile at actual points, lifting interval_nf_types to interval_types, and constructing decomposition_agreement. blockers.root_cause: Sub-interval splitting problem: zone matching u to u' does not preserve interval_nf_types for sub-intervals (x,u)/(x',u'). This is a structural limitation confirmed by 5+ implementation sessions. The EF game composition (GHR93 Proposition 7) is the only known resolution.
attempted_approaches: Direct NF induction on j (inner depth) -- fails: sub-interval types needed at every depth
Mutual recursion with nf_2var_from_interval_data at lower depth -- creates circularity
Splitting zone match (finding u' preserving decomposition) -- not provable from hypotheses
Direct game embedding inside StaviCompleteness -- similar complexity to full bridge
